title: ...breeze through airport security checkpoint lines
desc: Minimize wait times and avoid unnecessary bag searches or delays.
todos: Place liquids/gels under 3.4oz (100ml) in a clear 1-quart zip bag in outer pocket.
Keep boarding pass and physical photo ID accessible until through screening.
Remove heavy jackets, belts, metal items, and empty pockets into bins.
Pack large electronics (laptops/tablets) so they can be removed quickly.
Wear easy-to-remove slip-on shoes if you do not have TSA PreCheck/Global Entry.
